title: Decode One Instruction — 2026-09-06 (Windows x86-64)
blurb:
Challenge: Decode this instruction (Intel syntax), byte by byte:

83 7C C8 10 05

Give the mnemonic and full operands.

Answer: cmp dword ptr [rax+rcx*8+0x10], 0x5. `83` is the Group-1 opcode for an r/m32 destination with a sign-extended imm8 source; the /digit in ModRM's reg field picks the specific op (here /7 = CMP). ModRM 7C = 01 111 100: mod=01 (disp8 follows), reg=111 (CMP), rm=100 (read a SIB byte). SIB C8 = 11 001 000: scale=11b (x8), index=001 (RCX), base=000 (RAX) -> address = rax + rcx*8, then disp8=0x10 and imm8=0x05 complete the instruction.
